board_geometry_assumptions.rule: Use the populated footprint courtyards and critical-route feasibility to derive the board envelope before creating Edge.Cuts.

packing_phases.objective: Place U1, its power/decoupling, DSI_REXT, crystal and flash island with minimum loop and escape length.
packing_phases.stop_gate: U1 escape, QSPI and critical decoupling courtyards are feasible.

packing_phases.objective: Place U4 at a board edge, preserve its all-layer RF keepout and prove the four-bit SDIO escape.
packing_phases.stop_gate: No copper/component intrusion in the antenna keepout and SDIO routes remain feasible.

packing_phases.objective: Pack J1/eFuse/bulk/Kelvin shunt/3V3 conversion and the two USB VBUS switches as a short high-current tree.
packing_phases.stop_gate: J1/C3/C8 footprint gates remain explicit and current/thermal paths fit.

packing_phases.objective: Place J2/J3 with D2/D3 and prove HS/FS data plus mated-plug service corridors.
packing_phases.stop_gate: 90 ohm route topology and connector service access are feasible.

packing_phases.objective: Place generic J6 at a service-accessible board edge with FB3/C93/C94 local and prove U1-to-J6 routing.
packing_phases.stop_gate: 100 ohm clock/lane0/lane1 routes and generic FFC insertion clearance are feasible.

packing_phases.objective: Pack PCM5102A/RCA, microSD, recovery switches and factory headers around the established critical domains.
packing_phases.stop_gate: Analog isolation, card access and fixture access are feasible.

packing_phases.objective: Derive the minimum board outline, board-owned chassis holes and component-height zones from the completed packing.
packing_phases.stop_gate: Courtyards, edge clearances, mounting hardware and manufacturing constraints pass without display-derived geometry.

next_action: Create a reversible preliminary footprint placement in the KiCad PCB using board-local coordinates, with no production Edge.Cuts and no display-relative origin.
